name: Namchak Retreat Ranch
tradition: Tibetan Buddhism (Nyingma) — the Namchak lineage's dedicated retreat ranch and study center
teacherAccess: Retreats are led in person by Namchak teachers and facilitators, with group teachings, guided practice, Q&A, group dialogue, and (for some retreats) an optional individual empowerment.
retreatOptions: Weekend and 3-5 night residential retreats on the Seeker's Path and Practitioner's Path (e.g. Reset & Renew, Green Tara, Fundamentals of Tibetan Ritual Arts), most with an in-person-only, online, or hybrid option, plus a multi-year Three-Year Retreat program for advanced practitioners.
about: Namchak Retreat Ranch is a 10,000-acre former cattle ranch outside Hot Springs, Montana, developed by the Namchak Foundation as a dedicated home for Tibetan Buddhist practice, study, and retreat in the Nyingma lineage. Its main retreat building, the Bodhi House, holds a meditation hall and overnight rooms for about 30 students and opened in 2023; a separate three-year retreat center for long-term monastic-style retreat is also under construction on the land. Programs range from weekend introductory retreats on meditation and compassion practices to multi-day practitioner retreats on specific Vajrayana deity practices, taught by Namchak teachers and facilitators. Retreat fees are offered on a tiered, sliding-scale basis and include shuttle transportation from the Missoula airport, lodging, and three forest-to-table meals a day sourced partly from the ranch's own permaculture forest and greenhouse.
technique: Tibetan Buddhist meditation including Shamata (Calm Abiding), Tonglen (compassion practice), Loving-Kindness (Metta), and Vajrayana deity practices such as the Green Tara sadhana, alongside relational "Sangha Skills" exercises.
schedule: Retreat days combine group meditation and teaching sessions, guided practice, silent contemplative time, and group discussion; some retreats offer an optional two extra days of silent practice as an add-on after the main program.
cost: Tiered "Supported / Suggested / Sponsored" tuition per retreat (with a discounted Work Study rate), e.g. $500 / $650 / $800 for the 4-night, in-person Green Tara retreat, inclusive of shuttle, lodging, and three meals a day.

pricePerDay.notes: Derived from the 4-night (Oct 15-19, 2026) in-person Green Tara retreat's tiered tuition — Supported $500, Suggested $650, Sponsored $800 — divided by 4 nights; excludes the discounted Work Study rate. Tuition includes shuttle, lodging, and three meals a day.

foodNotes: Three meals a day are included in retreat tuition, described as "forest-to-table" and made largely from organic produce grown in the ranch's own permaculture forest and greenhouse; dietary requests and allergies can be accommodated on registration.
workNotes: Standard retreat attendance does not require work; a discounted "Work Study" tuition tier is offered for those who want to help in exchange for a reduced rate.
